summary: Zenta Group (Nasdaq: ZTG), a Macau professional services firm, agreed on September 9, 2026 to acquire 100% of ZentoAI Intelligent Technology for HKD10,000,000 cash plus US$5,844,490 in 12,278,340 newly issued class A ordinary shares at US$0.476 per share. The deal is a related-party transaction because CEO/Chairman Ng Wai Ian chairs ZentoAI's board; it was approved by the audit committee on August 16 and the board on August 21, 2026. New shares carry transfer restrictions; closing is subject to customary conditions. Post-closing shares outstanding total 24,087,179, comprising 17,719,499 class A and 6,367,680 class B. Watch related-party valuation, share overhang, and closing conditions.
